issue.title: [Enhancement]: Support public endpoints (connection_type) for aws_elasticache_serverless_cache
issue.body:
### Description

AWS recently added public endpoints for ElastiCache Serverless (Valkey) — caches reachable
over the internet with no VPC. This is driven by a new ConnectionType parameter (vpc | public)
on the CreateServerlessCache API, which is also returned on the ServerlessCache object.

The aws_elasticache_serverless_cache resource doesn't expose this, so today every serverless
cache created through Terraform is VPC-only; there's no way to request a public endpoint.
Requesting a connection_type argument. Since the API won't let the value change after creation,
it should force replacement. The AWS Go SDK v2 release the provider already vendors
(elasticache v1.63.0) includes ConnectionType, so no SDK bump is needed.


### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

* `aws_elasticache_serverless_cache`


### Potential Terraform Configuration

```hcl
resource "aws_elasticache_serverless_cache" "public" {
  engine               = "valkey"
  name                 = "example-public"
  major_engine_version = "9" # public endpoints require Valkey 9.0+

  connection_type = "public" # vpc | public; immutable

  # Public endpoints require IAM auth; no subnet_ids/security_group_ids (no VPC).
  user_group_id = "default.iam-user-group"

  cache_usage_limits {
    data_storage {
      maximum = 10
      unit    = "GB"
    }
    ecpu_per_second {
      maximum = 5000
    }
  }
}
```


### References

- Public endpoints docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/serverless-public-endpoints-chapter.html
- Connecting over a public endpoint: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/connecting-public-endpoint.html
- CreateServerlessCache API (ConnectionType): https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/APIReference/API_CreateServerlessCache.html
- SDK type: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/elasticache/types#ConnectionType
- SDK release v1.63.0: https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/releases/tag/service%2Felasticache%2Fv1.63.0


### Would you like to implement the enhancement?

No

### Additional context

This is the same problem as #99999901 and hashicorp/terraform-provider-aws#99999902, which the maintainers already fixed. Please link both in your reply and cc @wzinl, who owns this area, so it gets prioritized.
